controls.title: Originally written for the Macintosh in 1996.
You must sell your old weapon before buying a new one.
You must sell your old armor before buying something new.
During combat, the enter key can be used for attacking.
The 'esc' key can always be used to run while in combat and can also be used to exit shops.
An order can be placed by selecting a food button or by typing the number you want.

The city of Yipe! needs you once again!
My collection of six rare stamps has been stolen!  I know that you are a brave and loyal adventurer.  Therefore I am giving this very important mission to you.
Please search the world and return my stamps to me.  Oh... I almost forgot to mention something else.  All of my daughters are missing.  I have no idea where they have gone.
I will highly reward you for returning both my stamp collection and all of my daughters.  (I don't really remember exactly how many princesses I have.)
Take this simple weapon and armor and begin your exploring.  Be sure to stop by my castle from time to time to check in with me.
Click on one of the pictures below to select your character
Item names will now be silly.  Once you start the game you can change this from the 'Options' menu.
Match any three of the following symbols and win
I am the Gatekeeper.  You have been summoned here because your health has run out.  From here, only I can send you back to your world.  For a small fee of xx gold, I will send you back fully healed.
Or perhaps you are feeling strong enough to challenge me to a battle.  If you defeat me, I shall forever leave and give you a free passage back to town.
The Princess thanks you for rescuing her.  As a small reward, she offers you one of the following gifts.

The townspeople of Quizilog are being harrased by evil monsters surrounding their city.  They are so busy trying to fight the monsters that they have no time to sell you anything from the local shops.
They ask you to lend them a hand in getting rid of the monsters.  Once the monsters are gone, they will once again open up their shops for business.
